# Exact versions this project was measured against. GENERATED -- do not edit by
# hand; regenerate with:
#
#     .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip freeze --exclude-editable > requirements.lock.txt
#
# requirements.txt stays the human-readable list of DIRECT dependencies and the
# reasoning behind each. This file is the install path:
#
#     pip install -r requirements.lock.txt --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
#
# Why it exists: requirements.txt pins almost nothing, so `pip install -r` used
# to resolve ~101 packages fresh every time. A hijacked release of any one of
# them lands in a process that holds a websocket open to the internet, with no
# diff to review. Pinning does not stop a re-uploaded artifact at the same
# version -- only hashes do -- so if this ever guards something that matters,
# regenerate with `uv pip compile --generate-hashes` and install with
# --require-hashes.
#
# torch carries the +cpu local version: it resolves only from the PyTorch CPU
# index, which is deliberate (the GPU stays reserved for the LLM).
#
# Checking for known CVEs without installing a scanner into this venv:
#     pipx run pip-audit --strict -r requirements.lock.txt
# or commit this file and let GitHub Dependabot watch it.
